thread:
rachel: dropped the canary artifacts for rwd-v5p2-int4 at 4% traffic. quick tl;dr: latency and cost look good but we see concentrated quality dips on two slices. want to propose a per-slice priority model for automatic gates rather than a single global threshold. anyone opposed? :eyes:
omar: can you paste the slice delta table inline? need volumes and absolute deltas to reason about weighting.
devin: here's the blunt CSV from the run:
```
slice,queries,mrr,baseline_mrr,delta_abs,halluc_pp
search-chat,12200,0.792,0.790,+0.2,0.010
code-assist,2000,0.628,0.655,-2.7,0.021
long-summarize,900,0.498,0.520,-2.2,0.012
support-rank,3400,0.740,0.743,-0.3,0.004
```
rachel: code-assist and long-summarize are the culprits. code-assist hallucation delta is +1.1pp which worries me.
sophia: agree. per-slice priority makes sense. propose we build a small scoring function: slice_score = weight * (alpha * z_mrr + beta * halluc_pp_norm + gamma * kl_norm). then gate on aggregate or on any slice exceeding a local threshold. keeps high-impact slices from being drowned by global averages.
omar: what weights and coefficients do we use? We need something conservative to avoid flapping. Also add min_queries and coldstart ignore.
devin: draft numbers to iterate on: weights: code-assist=3.0, long-summarize=1.6, support-rank=1.0. coefficients: alpha=0.7, beta=0.2, gamma=0.1. local soft threshold per slice_score = 1.2, hard = 2.5. global sentinel if weighted_mean(slice_score) > 1.0 -> quiet-burn.
sophia: prefer per-slice overrides: code-assist_soft=0.9 (tighter), code-assist_hard=1.8. long-summarize_soft=1.4, long-summarize_hard=2.6. min_queries per window = 600 for code-assist and support-rank, 400 for long-summarize. coldstart_ignore_pct = 12.
rachel: operational actions: soft -> throttle to 15% and increase sampling x5 for the affected slice for 2h; spawn stealth shadow capture; notify #oncall-eng-ml. hard -> immediate rollback to pinned variant + page SRE. For Dedicated customers, soft should be a notify-only unless they opted in for auto-steer.
omar: add hallucation as a fast path: if halluc_delta_pp >= 0.8pp for high-weight slice (e.g., code-assist) sustained 20m -> escalate to soft immediately; if >=1.5pp sustained 15m -> hard rollback. hallucation is safety-first.
devin: ok adding halluc fast-path. also recommend a sustain window of two consecutive 15m windows for soft triggers to reduce noise, except for halluc fast-path which is single-window eligible. add cooldown 60m after any soft action on the same slice.
sophia: implementability note: gate engine needs per-slice config and a small SQL query to compute z_mrr and normalized halluc_pp on a rolling baseline. I'll stub this in the gate repo and add tests.
gate-bot: scheduled extended shadow job 1761248000 for code-assist x8 sampling; smoke checks: unit-tests e2, canary-load e2, quality-eval WARN (slices: code-assist, long-summarize)
rachel: next steps: 1) devin push per-slice config JSON with overrides + min-queries (PR today) 2) sophia add computation + tests in gate engine 3) omar update rollout playbook to document Dedicated vs Hosted behavior and halluc fast-path 4) devin collect shadow results tomorrow AM and we'll reconvene for final numeric signoff. tagging @omar for review. :white_check_mark:
omar: will review the PR once up. if shadow keeps halluc delta >0.7pp for code-assist we'll lower soft threshold to 0.7 and increase sampling multiplier. otherwise I think this per-slice scoring approach is the right path. :thumbsup:
